_meanings:
The rule according to which an ectype ({#vikfti#})
 sets aside a detail of its archetype ({#prakftiDarma#}) if it conflicts
 with some detail ({#Darma#}) which is expressly enjoined with reference
 to it. This is discussed and established by Jaimini and Śabara in <ls>MS. 5. 1. 19-22</ls>.
